claims.text: Amanjiwo is in the rural heartland of Central Java, surrounded by rainforest, hills and rice paddies.

findings.quote: surrounded by rainforest, hills and rice paddies, Amanjiwo occupies a special place in the rural heartland of Central Java.

claims.text: The resort overlooks the UNESCO World Heritage Site of Borobudur, one of Buddhism's most sacred Mahayana temples.

findings.quote: The resort overlooks the UNESCO World Heritage Site of Borobudur, one of Buddhism’s most sacred Mahayana temples.

claims.text: The resort lies at the foot of the Menoreh Hills and cascades down the hillside from a rotunda to a swimming pool.

findings.quote: the resort lies at the foot of the Menoreh Hills, cascading gracefully from a lofty rotunda down the hillside to a magnificent swimming pool.

claims.text: Amanjiwo is named 'peaceful soul' for the serenity, privacy and beauty of its setting.

findings.quote: Amanjiwo, named ‘peaceful soul’ for the serenity, privacy and beauty of its setting.

claims.text: Aman offers a Journey through Java by Train experience that ends with arrival at Amanjiwo after a seven-hour train journey.
